0022600151.text: The Milwaukee Bucks (1-3, 13th in the East and 5th in the Central, 2 games back) host the Cleveland Cavaliers (2-1, 6th in the East and 2nd in the Central, 0.5 games back), with Milwaukee at home at 1-1 and 0-2 on the road this season. Milwaukee enters on a one-game winning streak after losing three of its last four, while Cleveland is riding a two-game winning streak and is 2-0 at home. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Bucks lost the season series 1-3, including a 123-116 loss in Milwaukee on March 17, 2026.
